query_text: Make a school event and room booking calendar web app where students and staff can see all upcoming events on a monthly view, pick an available room to reserve, and get a quick confirmation so nobody has to chase down the admin office just to book a meeting room.

Make a peer tutor matching and session booking web app where students can search for tutors by subject, see their available time slots, and book a session in one go — so you're not wasting time sending emails back and forth just to set up a one-hour study meet.

Create a collaborative online whiteboard tool for live classroom use that runs in the browser, where a teacher can open a shared board and multiple students can draw, type, and add sticky notes at the same time during a lesson, with a simple toolbar that anyone can figure out in seconds.

Create a reading level and text complexity analyzer tool as a web app where I can paste in any chunk of text and get an instant readability score — like grade level and average sentence length — so I can figure out whether an article is too hard for my students before I assign it.

Need an accreditation evidence and documentation management web app where our department can upload supporting files, tag each document to the right accreditation standard, and track which requirements are still missing — so we're not scrambling through shared drives looking for proof files two weeks before the review.

Create an annual report interactive infographic display site that feels sophisticated and editorial — the kind of website where the numbers come alive through beautiful charts and timelines you can hover over, with a clean typographic hierarchy and a color palette that feels intentional and premium, built for desktop browsers so all the details have space to shine.

Need a press freedom global index visualization website that feels serious and visually striking — the kind of site where you see an interactive world map with countries shaded by their press freedom score, and clicking a country gives you a concise profile with the key numbers and context, designed to work beautifully in a desktop browser.

Build a travel narrative and destination writing publication website that feels like a gorgeous literary travel magazine — rich, atmospheric hero images for each story, unhurried editorial typography that makes the writing feel cinematic, and a layout for desktop browsers where every destination piece feels like an invitation to get lost in someone's vivid first-person account.

Create an environmental and climate crisis reporting magazine website with a visual identity that feels urgent but thoughtful — deep, moody photography paired with clear, impactful headlines, a layout designed for long reads in a desktop browser, and the kind of editorial weight that makes you feel the seriousness of each story the moment you land on the home screen.
